### raw


```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(lavaan)
library(broom)
df_data <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part0_treat\\semdata\\sem_lr_sws7_au_to_25_cluster.csv")


model <- '
    level: 1
        value ~ sw_value + density + log_Koil_air + sp_weight + sp_troph + po_xlogp +  organ_muscle + melting_point
        sw_value ~ po_m_w + log_Koa_wet + solubility 

    level: 2
        value ~ sw_value
        sw_value ~ TOTALS_CO2_E * GDP + port_distance + SF6 + HCFC + mine_distance + tcsw + estuary_distance + global_salinity
        tcsw ~ ctp + str + ssr + i10fg + v10 + u10 + ref_ice

        
'

fit <- sem(model, data = df_data,cluster = "cluster", optim.method = "em", em.iter.max=10000)

summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE)
